subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` inside shared user/workspace path resolvers, or should env interpolation stay limited to config-load and dotenv semantics?
rationale: The code change is mechanically small, but it changes shared path/config behavior for existing users and overlaps the broader dotenv expansion policy tracked separately.

options.title: Adopt resolver expansion
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with resolver-level expansion plus regression coverage for configured workspaces and ClawHub skill install targets.

options.title: Keep interpolation at config load
options.body: Document paths as config-substituted values and fix only the install/config path that is supposed to receive already-expanded values.

options.title: Defer to dotenv policy
options.body: Keep this issue linked while the broader dotenv/env-expansion contract is decided before changing shared path behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt resolver expansion
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with resolver-level expansion plus regression coverage for configured workspaces and ClawHub skill install targets.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest current history on both the shared path resolver and native ClawHub install flow.
